messages:
Zara: Morning — post-launch backlog review. Need to decide sprint placements for three items: a reranker quality regression, a customer request for per-route model pinning, and a perf opt for tokenization that reduces cost. Quick takes?

Ethan: List + IDs please.

Zara: From support/telemetry:
RD-10011 — reranker scoring drift vs baseline (multiple customers)
RD-10028 — request: per-route model pinning (CustZ)
RD-10045 — tokenizer micro-optim: 8-12% token cost reduction (infra/product)

Marta: Initial read: RD-10011 looks like a quality regression — treat as bug P0 (affects search and retrieval flows). RD-10028 is a product enhancement (high-value for CustZ). RD-10045 is a cost-saving engineering initiative — high ROI but might need infra validation.

Vin: Observability note — reranker drift shows spike after model variant rollout two days ago. We can roll back quickly but need acceptance criteria.

Celine: PM perspective: CustZ asked for model pinning because they run sensitive evaluation across routes. This is enterprise tier feature; could be gated behind Dedicated. How fast do they want it?

Zara: CustZ asked for ETA within 3 sprints. They flagged it as blocker for their go-live.

Ethan: Proposal: Sprint A (next 2 weeks): emergency triage for RD-10011 — reproduce + small rollback if root cause confirmed. Also spike for RD-10028 API design (1 dev-day) so we can present scope to CustZ. Sprint B: land RD-10045 tokenizer opt (if non-invasive) and continue RD-10028 implementation. Sprint C: full RD-10028 rollout and docs + gating rules.

Marta: Agree. For RD-10011 acceptance: failing reproducer in test harness, rollback plan, canary at 10% for 24h, and customer verification from affected parties.

Vin: I can cut a safe rollback to previous reranker variant and gate by quality metric. Will need on-call window for canary.

Celine: For RD-10028 we should scope minimal MVP: per-route pinning via API flag + UI toggle for enterprise, with audit logs. Security review required. If CustZ signs an enterprise addendum, we can prioritize.

Ethan: RD-10045 tokenizer opt: ops asked for a performance spike validation. If the change is pure software and passes unit/perf tests we could land in Sprint B. Otherwise push to roadmap.

Zara: Vote check — +1 to prioritize RD-10011 in Sprint A and spike RD-10028 design now. React with :+1: to confirm.

Marta: +1

Vin: +1

Celine: +1

Ethan: +1

TriBot: Ticket RD-10100 created: "post-launch: reranker rollback + per-route pinning spike" (created by Zara).

Zara: Action items:
- Vin: execute rollback if QA confirms repro (ETA today).
- Ethan: open design doc + API sketch for RD-10028 (ETA 48h).
- Marta: draft customer comms for affected customers and CustZ update.
- Infra/Eng: evaluate RD-10045 perf test plan next week.

Ethan: I'll attach a minimal API sketch to the ticket and list security questions.

Vin: Will post canary results to triage channel.

Marta: I'll send a short customer note: "We identified reranker drift and are rolling a targeted rollback/canary this sprint; we will update within 24 hours."

Zara: Thanks — will follow up in the weekly roadmap sync and update the sprint board.

TriBot: Ticket RD-10101 created: "customer comms: reranker drift update" (created by Marta).

Ethan: +1
